content:
maya: Quick flag  saw other-org rows in Insights after hopping tabs fast. repro: orgA -> orgB -> back to orgA, rows for orgB persisted.
liam: can repro once in ~4 tries. network shows two concurrent fetches with same session but different X-Org headers.
jun-sre: that indicates session-scoped cache key is too coarse. prefetch writes session->payload and on-demand reads without verifying request org.
alejandra: client adds X-Tab-Id for prefetch. server cache currently keys only by session. should include X-Tab-Id and X-Org to avoid collisions.
vikram: does this affect billing/quotas? i see an attribution blip for orgB earlier. finance alerted.
maya: looks like read-only UI leak but metrics attributed some counts to orgB. putting a ticket in billing.
liam: short-term: drop prefetch for multi-tenant endpoints and add guard that rejects cached hit when cached.meta.org != req.headers['x-org']. prefer ignore-cache + fetch origin rather than 4xx.
jun-sre: agree. action: toggle off prefetch on canary, add metric 'prefetch.tenant_mismatch' and alert if >0 for 5m.
deploy-bot: feature 'console-prefetch' toggled OFF in prod-canary at 2026-03-01T11:02:00Z.
alejandra: long-term: change cache key to include {session, tab_id, org} and update docs. also add unit tests for concurrent tab flips.
vikram: (vikram) I'll coordinate with finance to verify billing backfill and rollback any mis-attribution.
maya: i'll attach HAR + short vid to the ticket. please tag me when guard lands so i can validate.
liam: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge/pull/4410 with ignore-on-mismatch and metric.
jun-sre: checklist: 1) canary toggle off (done) 2) land and roll guard 3) cache-key change + client patch for X-Tab-Id 4) billing audit 5) postmortem.
maya: thanks all. ping here for verification. :thumbsup:
